title: Misaligned Clinical Risk Classification and Cost Asymmetry in Open-Weight Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23999v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: How large language models (LLMs) integrate patient risk with clinical cost tradeoffs remains poorly understood. We investigated how four open-weight LLMs (Qwen-2.5-7B/32B and Llama-3.1-8B/70B) internally represent cost tradeoffs, how these representations relate to clinical predictions, and whether decisions shift as predicted by the specified cost direction and magnitude. Using a public diabetes dataset, we varied 11 false-negative (FN) to false-positive (FP) cost ratios across three phrasings and examined representations and behavioral outputs. Patient risk was linearly recoverable on par with conventional classifiers (AUC $\approx 0.83$), and cost direction was recoverable in every model. However, representational shifts in cost direction tracked output changes only in the two larger models, and responses to cost magnitude were predominantly direction-agnostic. translated_title: 开源权重大语言模型中临床风险分类与成本不对称的错位
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）如何将患者风险与临床成本权衡相结合，目前仍知之甚少。我们研究了四个开源权重LLM（Qwen-2.5-7B/32B和Llama-3.1-8B/70B）如何在内部表征成本权衡、这些表征与临床预测之间的关系，以及决策是否按所指定成本方向和幅度的预期发生变化。利用公开的糖尿病数据集，我们在三种表述方式下变换了11种假阴性（FN）与假阳性（FP）成本比率，并考察了模型的表征与行为输出。结果显示，患者风险可被线性恢复，效果与传统分类器相当（AUC ≈ 0.83），且成本方向在每个模型中均可恢复。然而，成本方向的表征变化仅在两个较大的模型中与输出变化相一致，而对成本幅度的响应大多与方向无关。在12个模型-表述组合中，仅有2个对成本增加同时表现出相反的响应……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该研究发现开源大语言模型虽能在内部表征患者风险与成本方向，但其临床决策输出与设定的成本不对称性存在错位——仅较大模型的表征变化能反映到输出，且对成本幅度普遍不敏感。
en_tdlr: Open-weight LLMs internally encode patient risk and cost direction, but their clinical decisions are misaligned with specified cost asymmetries—representational shifts track output changes only in larger models, and responses to cost magnitude are largely direction-agnostic.
